changelog:
GAMBIT — One Sentence, Whole Formation. No integration, no plugin, no root, no YAML. Speak and lights, screen, pages, settings all play out.

Pick a brain: local model offline, cloud model, or OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Free key at build.nvidia.com, endpoint integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1, OpenAI-compatible, runs in minutes. Five endpoint slots, fallback chain: two transport failures move task with ledger to next slot, completed actions never run twice. Path: Settings → Voice configuration → Text to understanding → LLM language engine.

Chess formation: King (Ava center — dim screen, lock, mute, timer, overlays, volume), Queen (house devices — lights, blinds, thermostat, fan, humidifier, Roomba, mower, scenes, locks, alarms, sensors, cameras), Rooks (pages/settings — automations, scripts, scenes, themes, energy, backups, Zigbee, TTS volume, touch pad, microphone, voiceprint), Knight (web — weather, URLs, scroll, tap, copy, paste, refresh, back), Bishops (music/nearby Avas — play, skip, seek, call, video, broadcast), Pawns (apps/touch pad — Calculator, Spotify floating window, recorded automations replay). Rules: ordered jobs, failed first blocks second; same-named devices return candidates; locks/alarms need named targets and verbatim codes; camera frames to model eyes; browser isolates from house pieces; every page returns to start; unlanded tap never claimed as done.

Every step has receipt: observed, sent, queued, applied, unknown. Model speaks only to status. Ledger prevents re-run. Failed twice blocked on third. Unknown service read one section at a time. Long jobs: 10-min budget, up to 8 slices, silent continuation from checkpoint.

Touch pad: triple-tap bottom-left corner, translucent pad floats up. Finger slides on pad, cursor moves on screen. Tap click, long-press hold, two-finger back/scroll, three-finger pinch resizes floating windows. Acceleration curve, haptics. Record automation: press record, do once, replay with flash marks. Five slots, loopable. No root, standard Android overlay/accessibility APIs. Android 7+. Path: Settings → Device services → Sidebar → Touch pad.

Voice configuration reordered in six steps: wake, capture, recognition, understanding, execution, speech. Voice channel master switch, wake settings, microphone, smart voiceprint, STT engine, text-to-understanding, understanding-to-speech, ambient listening events. MOD store installs top two engines directly.

Wake second gate: first engine hears, second re-checks same clip. Strict+ lets unsure through, Extreme refuses unsure. Self-learning gathers home samples, publishes new head at 90% survival. Voiceprint templates per engine, enrolment and real wakes same PCM. Misleading STOP triggers fixed.

Voice button: press once speak done, hold-to-talk up to 2 minutes, auto-renews ESPHome window at ~13s, HA receives one complete sentence. Night quiet-reply level, auto gain only adds never cuts below floor. Path: Settings → Voice configuration.

Stuck? Pull down system shade, each layer posts row, tap Exit closes layer, HA display switch follows. Android 5-16. #218 @floco. Heavy dashboards: WebView Health Manager tightens subscription, pressure and frame rate visible.

Fixes: #212 Sendspin Android 5.1.1 crash @ly2199. #213 MA 2.11 instability @pantherale0. #215 Bluetooth GATT 133 reconnects per HA address type, remembers fast failures 10 min @oooshk. #216 browser dead after Gecko on old devices, recovery ladder Android 5-16 @pantherale0. #217 Portal Chrome 131 reported as 14, transpiler off in settings @sng492. #221 NSPanel Pros shared ESPHome identity, wlan0 MAC mixed in, regenerate in one tap @solarexpertscr. #218 Quick Entities fullscreen no back @floco.
